text:
```yaml
name: Claude PR critique

on:
  pull_request:
    types: [opened, synchronize, reopened]

permissions:
  pull-requests: write

jobs:
  lint_and_comment:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Set up Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: '20'
          cache: 'npm'

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: npm ci

      - name: Run lint, typecheck, tests in web
        run: |
          cd web
          npm run lint
          npm run typecheck
          npm test

      - name: Run lint, typecheck, tests in apps
        run: |
          cd apps
          npm run lint
          npm run typecheck
          npm test

      - name: Run lint, typecheck, tests in electron
        run: |
          cd electron
          npm run lint
          npm run typecheck
          npm test

      - name: Claude PR critique
        uses: anthropic/claude@v1
        with:
          anthropic_api_key: ${{ secrets.ANTHROPIC_API_KEY }}
          model: claude-3-5-sonnet-20240620
          prompt: |
            You are a senior software engineer reviewing a pull request. Provide a concise critique of the changes described in the PR title and body. Highlight any potential issues, improvements, or questions. Keep it short (max 3-4 sentences).

            PR Title: ${{ github.event.pull_request.title }}
            PR Body: ${{ github.event.pull_request.body }}
          max_tokens: 200
          temperature: 0.7
          role: assistant
          output_format: comment
```
